panels.title: Proxy HTTP requests by status
panels.description: Requests per interval served by the Kotlin proxy, by status.

panels.title: Retrieval HTTP requests by status
panels.description: Requests per interval served by the retrieval-server, by status.

panels.title: Proxy HTTP latency
panels.description: Request latency percentiles for the Kotlin proxy.

panels.title: Retrieval HTTP latency
panels.description: Request latency percentiles for the retrieval-server.

panels.title: Proxy CPU utilization (%)
panels.description: Busy CPU as % of all cores: 100 minus the average per-core idle rate (fly_instance_cpu is a per-core centiseconds counter).

panels.title: Retrieval CPU utilization (%)
panels.description: Busy CPU as % of all cores: 100 minus the average per-core idle rate (fly_instance_cpu is a per-core centiseconds counter).

panels.title: Agent runs by status
panels.description: Durable agent_run workflows finished per interval, by status. 'error' counts turns that ended with an error and workflows that raised.

panels.title: Agent runs in flight
panels.description: Executions started minus executions finished since the process started (both counters reset on a restart): runs in progress, including ones waiting for human input.

panels.title: Recoveries and restarts
panels.description: Runs re-executed after a restart (durable_run_recovered_total) and retrieval server process restarts (deploys, crashes, OOM kills).

panels.title: Dead-lettered runs
panels.description: Runs DBOS stopped recovering (MAX_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED), counted once by the run sweep. agent_run: the user saw an error. request_agent_run: capped at 0 attempts, every restart that interrupts one dead-letters it.

panels.title: Interrupted tool calls
panels.description: Tool calls a restart interrupted and a re-execution refused to run again (the model got an error result instead), by tool.

panels.title: Request agent runs by status
panels.description: Durable request agents (titles, personas, memory extraction) finished per interval, by status.

panels.title: PDF render time p50/p95
panels.description: Wall time of one generate_pdf call (queue + render + store), by renderer.

panels.title: PDF renders by status
panels.description: generate_pdf calls per interval by renderer and status (ok, error, oom, timeout, busy, rejected).

panels.title: PDF child peak RSS p50/p95
panels.description: Peak RSS of the render worker child after a render, by renderer.

panels.title: PDF queue wait p50/p95
panels.description: Time a render waited for the machine-wide heavy-job slot.

panels.title: PDF render warnings by kind
panels.description: Renderer warnings per interval, by renderer and kind (counts only, never text).

panels.title: PDF rejections by reason
panels.description: generate_pdf calls refused before rendering (caps), by reason.

panels.title: PDF render CPU p95
panels.description: CPU seconds of the render itself, and of worker spawns (renderer import), by renderer.

panels.title: PDF tool calls by status
panels.description: generate_pdf / revise_pdf tool executions per interval, by status.

panels.title: Web search
panels.description: Tavily web-search calls per interval, by status (ok / error / missing_key).
